description: Clean A/B vs exp042 (1.7852 @ 8k). Identical model except: dominance residual stream (P=2016) replaces per-layer concat. token_to_dom = V2D(E=64) initialises stream; each block reads via D2V(64) and adds α·out_proj-dominance back to stream (no canon, no LN, learnable α per layer init=1.0); drops out_canon/out_to_vec/concat. Unembedder: D2V(64) → Linear(64, 384=6E) → ReLU → Linear(384, V) — 6E hidden chosen to match exp042's 12.6M unembedder param budget. Q/K joint MultiHeadLut, V/out_proj BitPermutationLUT, all hyperparameters preserved.
